successors.text: Zhenfan, 'probably located in the region south of Lelang, although there is some uncertainty' (Bowman, Zhenfan page); 'Its territorial jurisdiction is unclear'

ledger.x: 82 BCE: Zhenfan is abolished into Lelang.

wars.name: Han conquest of Wiman Joseon
wars.outcome: The Han destroy Wiman Chosŏn in 108 BCE and set up Lelang, Lintun and Zhenfan.

certainty.note: Site and extent are unknown; draw it faint or not at all.
